const currentCategoryId = CATEGORY_ORDER[rotIdx];

staticData[ROTATION_KEY] = String((rotIdx + 1) % CATEGORY_ORDER.length);

const feeds = CATEGORY_FEEDS[currentCategoryId] || CATEGORY_FEEDS[1];
const shuffled = [...feeds].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
const fetchLimit = 8; // Fetch 8 feeds to get a giant pool
let allFeedData = [];

for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(fetchLimit, shuffled.length); i++) {

      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)' }

    const body = typeof resp === 'string' ? resp : (resp.data || resp.body || '');
    if (body) allFeedData.push(String(body));
  } catch(e) {}
}

return [{ json: {

## 🍳 texasdadcooks.com — Gemini Auto Blog v6

✅ Gemini 2.5 Flash for content (12K tokens)
✅ Pexels API images + copyright attribution
✅ ROUND-ROBIN CATEGORY ROTATION 🔄
✅ Category-specific RSS feeds
✅ 3 inline images + proper copyright attribution
✅ Merge node waits for all 3 images
✅ 1500-2000 words | Deep SEO | AdSense Ready
✅ TOC + max 2 science/research outbound links
✅ Max 2 internal links (non-spammy)
✅ Recipe disclaimer + image license credits
🔴 Auto-stops: 08-Apr-2027

🔧 v6 CATEGORY ROTATION UPGRADE:
- 🔄 ROUND-ROBIN: Each run picks NEXT category
- Run 1→Cat 27, Run 2→Cat 28, ... Run 10→Cat 36, Run 11→Cat 27
- Category-SPECIFIC RSS feeds (10 feeds per category)
- Category-SPECIFIC fallback topics (5 per category)
- Gemini FORCED to write for assigned category
- Gemini's own category choice is IGNORED
- Ensures ALL 10 categories get articles evenly

📋 CATEGORY ROTATION ORDER:
27 = Quick & Easy Recipes → Run 1, 11, 21...
28 = Breakfast Recipes → Run 2, 12, 22...
29 = Lunch Ideas → Run 3, 13, 23...

🔑 WP: Texas Dad @ texasdadcooks.com
